0.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧Bring four genomes into one connected view. Combine straight and curved backbones, strand-aware genes and the default stepped identity scale without hiding where the data came from.⟦shared:1⟧

2.translation: This view asks where observed alignments lie across four complete source records and which original CDS occur near their endpoints. It is not a phylogenetic tree and does not independently establish inversions or function. Check the accession records at NCBI: [MT108731.1](⟦shared:0⟧), [MT118296.1](⟦shared:1⟧), [OQ646790.1](⟦shared:2⟧), [OR222515.1](⟦shared:3⟧).

3.translation: Length/identity thresholds, at most three HSPs per pair and strand-aware CDS sampling are display choices. Original FASTA/GFF3/BLAST records stay unchanged. Rotation, curvature, radius and reversal affect display only; labels retain source names. Consult complete GFF3 before reporting gene presence or absence.

6.translation: Compare the dark blue ⟦shared:0⟧ and teal ⟦shared:1⟧ backbones first. Their radii are 0.82 and 1.18. Orange ⟦shared:2⟧ and red ⟦shared:3⟧ use 1.02 and 1.08. Radius separates backbones visually. Read sequence lengths from the bp ticks. [Compare radius on its own](⟦shared:4⟧).

7.translation: CDS are sampled separately for each available source strand, without a length threshold. Neither MT record has a negative-strand CDS. The sole negative-strand CDS on OQ646790.1 is 207 bp. An explicit Position places positive-strand arrows inside and negative-strand arrows outside. Arrow direction, colour and data retain the source strands. Positive-strand sampling favours CDS that overlap displayed link endpoints so the view demonstrates local ribbon clearance. Every arrow uses its original annotation as the label, including hypothetical protein.

9.translation: Extract the [manual input bundle](⟦shared:0⟧) into the working directory, so it contains ⟦shared:1⟧. Install the optional example packages with ⟦shared:2⟧; they prepare tables, map lists and inspect endpoint columns.

10.translation: Put the preparation script in your working directory. It contains the input, selection and display settings.

12.translation: The input contains four unchanged FASTA records, their GFF3 annotations and 32 original HSPs. The display keeps HSPs at least 900 bp long and at least 75% identical, with at most three per sequence pair. This reduces clutter without merging or inventing alignments.

18.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧, ⟦shared:2⟧ | Adjust display direction, bend and radius per sequence. Zero curvature draws a straight backbone. |

19.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧ | Add space between backbones and turn the whole layout to position the elements. |

20.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧ | Leave smooth clearance near gene arrows and show overlaps through translucent ribbons. |

21.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧ | Place arrows on opposite sides by source strand with offsets of ±0.030. Narrower arrows sit close to the backbones, and labels use the same position. |

22.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧ | Arrange gene labels radially and wrap longer names. |

23.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ and the default stepped scale | Map percent identity to ribbon colour and show the default stepped scale. |

25.translation: Start with the sequence colours and gene directions, then trace the larger aligned intervals. A ribbon crossing is not evidence of a rearrangement by itself. Read alignment identity using the default stepped colour scale.

26.translation: Use [link filtering](⟦shared:0⟧) to change the display threshold, [labels](⟦shared:1⟧) to choose annotation density, or [sequence parameters](⟦shared:2⟧) to change radius and curvature. For a file-by-file introduction, start with [original sequence comparisons](⟦shared:3⟧).

30.translation: Preview with view_ggchord at the declared width/height and save with ggsave at matching dimensions. Check IDs, source strands, endpoint directions, selection reports, legend units and hidden-label reasons. A successful PNG does not certify font portability across PDF/SVG viewers. Keep complete source tables, display subsets, parameters, version and input hashes. Download the [asset/provenance record](⟦shared:0⟧).

32.translation: The package code is MIT-licensed; source database records and reference catalogues retain their original terms. The package license does not relicense third-party data. Keep accession identities and provenance with exported figures. The [asset/source record](⟦shared:0⟧), input archive hashes and displayed preparation script document this example; algorithmic matches remain hypotheses for experimental verification.
